description: Client-side JavaScript for managing delegate selection, bulk actions, and modal popups in SuiteCRM/F.P. Events module, including functions for selecting/deselecting checkboxes, handling delegate status updates, and opening various popups for target lists, contacts, leads, and delegate management.

methods.name: selectPageTop
methods.description: Selects all checkboxes on the current page and hides the subnav.

methods.name: selectAllTop
methods.description: Selects all checkboxes and disables them, sets a flag for entire list.

methods.name: deselectTop
methods.description: Deselects all checkboxes, enables them, and clears hidden input.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Updates hidden input with checked checkbox values.

methods.name: set_return_and_save_background2
methods.description: Sends selected records to server and reloads page.

methods.name: select_targets
methods.description: Opens modal to select target lists, contacts, leads, etc.

methods.name: handle_targetlists
methods.description: Opens popup for selecting prospect lists.

methods.name: manage_delegates
methods.description: Shows modal for managing delegate statuses.

methods.name: showNoCheck
methods.description: Displays error modal when no checkboxes are selected.

methods.name: handle_invited
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as invited via AJAX.

methods.name: handle_not_invited
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as not invited via AJAX.

methods.name: handle_attended
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as attended via AJAX.

methods.name: handle_not_attended
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as not attended via AJAX.

methods.name: manage_acceptances
methods.description: Shows modal for managing delegate acceptances.

methods.name: handle_accepted
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as accepted via AJAX.

methods.name: handle_declined
methods.description: Marks selected delegates as declined via AJAX.
